protocol.blueQuestion: What breaks the capture-and-recovery journey if this requirement is absent?
protocol.redQuestion: Can the requirement move later without losing the original utterance, recovery, single action, or legacy-path safety?
protocol.rule: Domain relevance is insufficient; retain only the first behavior actually consumed by RP1.

moved.title: 粗略想法结构化
moved.reason: Structured interpretation is the V2 outcome; RP1 only preserves the source and starts interpretation.

moved.title: 单轮消息理解
moved.reason: RP1 atomizes the message, while semantic routing to decisions, revisions, and constraints begins in V2.

moved.title: 先看一版的安全语义
moved.reason: Exploratory prose candidates are explicitly excluded from the capture-only release.

moved.title: 误解与漂移纠正
moved.reason: Correcting an interpretation graph first requires a V2 understanding snapshot.

moved.title: 资产版本与指纹
moved.reason: The first versioned semantic asset is the understanding snapshot; RP1 source events use immutable event identity.

moved.title: 兼容投影适配器
moved.reason: Compatibility projections for contract, outline, prose, and obligation models are first consumed by the contract slice.

moved.title: 采纳变更计划
moved.reason: RP1 writes one source event; multi-canon-asset MutationPlan semantics begin with contract adoption.

moved.title: 可恢复多资产提交
moved.reason: Recoverable multi-canon-asset commit is not exercised by source capture and begins with contract adoption.

moved.title: 权威提交与投影顺序
moved.reason: Canon commit and projection ordering starts when a semantic candidate can be adopted.

moved.title: 可回滚迁移
moved.reason: RP1 adds session/event schema but performs no project-content migration; project checkpoints begin before contract migration.

moved.title: 异步长任务
moved.reason: The first newly governed asynchronous AI task is interpretation, not source capture.

moved.title: 可分享定位链接
moved.reason: Stable links first target a question or understanding artifact; RP1 only restores the project/session location.

moved.title: 低风险自动决定回执
moved.reason: Autonomy receipts record semantic low-risk decisions, which RP1 is forbidden to make while only capturing source.

conclusion: RP1 is reduced to source capture, recovery, one-action UX, and compatibility guards; downstream semantic work no longer counts in its denominator.
